✳ Arafath Tours ✳

See the place.
Meet its people.

Our full-day Vaikom experience brings together time on the water, village craft visits and a traditional Kerala lunch. Hotel pickup and drop-off make it easy to settle into the day.

Alongside the village tour, ask us about airport transfers, local cab facilities and outstation journeys across Kerala.
